landing.headline: More time for coaching. Less time on admin.
landing.intro: An AI-first workspace for chess teachers: students, groups, schedules, attendance, lesson notes and learning history. Record through connected AI assistants and review or correct everything on the website.
landing.notice: Built using MIT-licensed CogNote components. ChessCoachPal original development is proprietary; integrations and coaching workflows remain under active development.
landing.f1Detail: Record lessons, attendance and notes with connected ChatGPT or Claude tools as they become available.
landing.f2Detail: Track individual and group teaching with one record per student.
landing.f3Detail: See your lessons across schools, clubs and private practice.
landing.f4Detail: Self-host, review and correct records on the website even without AI.
landing.credits: ChessCoachPal · MIT licensed · Based on CogNote by Andres Jaime Morales

help.title: ChessCoachPal help
help.lead: The website works without an AI subscription. Use it for review, corrections and all core teacher workflows.
help.release: Before publishing v0.1.0, follow the release gate and test both real ChatGPT and Claude clients against a locally managed synthetic instance.
help.section1Description: Create a workplace for each school, chess club, online group or private teaching practice. Each workplace has its own timezone and policies.
help.section2Description: Add students, keep private teaching notes and optionally connect families to a private portal for their schedule, invoices and shared notes.
help.section3Description: Create class groups and enroll students, or schedule individual lessons. The session roster is frozen at creation, so attendance history remains accurate even when group membership changes. Record each student's attendance independently.
help.section4Description: Track chess skill observations, review suggestions made by AI agents, and save curated HTTPS or Lichess Study links. Suggestions are unverified until you explicitly approve them in the website.
help.section5Description: Connect a supported ChatGPT or Claude client through delegated OAuth and MCP. Agent actions are scoped to your teacher account and never receive a service-role key. Live client interoperability is reserved for final v0.1.0 release acceptance.
help.section6Description: Configure your profile, notifications and optional services. ChessCoachPal is self-hostable. Back up both your PostgreSQL database and any uploaded objects before resetting or replacing a development installation.

privacyPage.title: Privacy and data ownership
privacyPage.intro: ChessCoachPal is source-visible chess coaching software. This page describes the application, not the privacy policy of any particular hosting operator.
privacyPage.operatorBody: The teacher or organization running your instance controls its hosting, database, backups, logs, retention period, email delivery, optional payments and connected AI providers. ChessCoachPal contributors do not automatically receive records stored on independent installations. Contact your hosting operator for their privacy notice and privacy-request details.
privacyPage.storedBody: The application can store teacher accounts, workplaces, students and family contacts, birth dates, lesson schedules, attendance, private and shared coaching notes, chess learning observations and study links, invoices and payment records. Family portals are accessible to anyone with their private portal link; protect and rotate these links when necessary.
privacyPage.authBody: Session cookies authenticate teachers. Delegated AI clients receive teacher-authorized OAuth permissions. Optional email, payments, AI and other integrations can send information to providers selected by the operator or teacher. Never expose a service-role database key to a client or AI agent.
privacyPage.childrenBody: Teachers and operators must obtain applicable permissions, restrict access, handle correction and deletion requests, and meet their legal child-privacy obligations. Do not enter identifiable real students, personal records or production credentials in public demo or CI environments.
privacyPage.retentionBody: Teachers can export records from Account settings. Exports contain sensitive information and need separate protection. Operators must manage database and uploaded-object backups, retention, deletion and incident response. No hosting region, retention period, contact address or contractual guarantee is implied by this open-source repository.
privacyPage.securityAfter: for implementation guidance, and ask your deployment operator about their actual practices.

termsPage.title: Software license and hosting terms
termsPage.intro: ChessCoachPal is chess teaching software that can be self-hosted under the applicable license terms. The current ChessCoachPal contributions are proprietary, while specified earlier and third-party material retains its own licenses.
termsPage.licenseBefore: The repository contains source-visible proprietary ChessCoachPal contributions. Their permitted use is defined in the
termsPage.licenseMiddle: Prior ChessCoachPal and CogNote MIT-licensed contributions retain applicable rights; see
termsPage.licenseAfter: Public source access does not itself grant permission to redistribute proprietary portions. This page does not replace any license.
termsPage.hostingBody: Each installation is run by its own operator. If your chess teacher, school, club or service provider hosts your account, ask them for applicable terms, data practices, pricing, support arrangements and availability. The source repository makes no claim that a specific paid hosting service or central support organization is available.
termsPage.responsibleBody: Operators and teachers must obtain appropriate permissions to hold students' and families' records, protect credentials and private links, comply with applicable laws, and check redistribution rights before uploading teaching materials. Optional AI, payments and email services have separate provider terms.
termsPage.contractBody: Installing this software does not create a subscription, hosting agreement, service-level guarantee or legal relationship with its contributors. Separate hosting contracts, if any, are between the user and their chosen operator.

compensation.groupExcluded: {count, plural, one {# lesson uses a separate group agreement and is excluded here.} other {# lessons use separate group agreements and are excluded here.}}
compensation.exactExcluded: {count, plural, one {# lesson has its own agreement and is excluded here.} other {# lessons have their own agreements and are excluded here.}}
compensation.supersededReview: This request may have been saved and then revised. Check the existing agreement before taking any new action.
compensation.pendingReview: The last request is not confirmed. Retry the same reviewed agreement before changing it.
compensation.title: Compensation agreements
compensation.intro: Keep expected coaching earnings and customer charges separate. Previews are not invoices or received payments.
compensation.chooseScope: Choose the exact student or group
compensation.archiveConfirm: Archive this agreement? Existing financial records are not changed.
compensation.noAgreements: No agreements in this workplace yet.
compensation.previewNotice: Read-only estimate. Does not post an obligation, invoice, salary payment or customer receipt.
compensation.chooseCounterparty: Select a billing account for this workplace

federationRatings.title: Federation IDs and official rating history
federationRatings.warning: Player IDs and ratings entered here are teacher claims, not verified FIDE or national-federation records. Never treat ratings as a substitute for teacher strength assessment.
federationRatings.readError: Federation records could not be loaded.
federationRatings.defaultDisclaimer: Suggested for this student: {code}. This does not create membership or prove an external registration.

payerAssignments.title: Who pays for this student?
payerAssignments.disclaimer: A payer must be explicitly assigned for each workplace and effective date. Contacts, families and portal links never create debt automatically. Existing invoices and payments are not changed by this editor.
payerAssignments.noPayer: No billing account assigned. No charge can be created without an explicit payer.
payerAssignments.confirmPayer: Assign this billing account as this student’s payer for the selected workplace and dates? No invoice or charge will be created.
payerAssignments.endPrompt: Enter the last effective date for this payer (YYYY-MM-DD)
payerAssignments.confirmEnd: End the current payer assignment on this date? History remains available.

postedEarnings.title: Posted coaching earnings
postedEarnings.description: Approved lesson earnings only, by recorded lesson date. Applied receipts reflect current allocations and reversals. Forecasts, unallocated receipts, monthly salary and invoices are not included.
postedEarnings.allPayers: All billing accounts in this report
postedEarnings.unavailable: Posted earnings are unavailable. Check the workplace, currency and dates (up to 366 days), then try again.
postedEarnings.postedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No posted lessons match these filters} one {# posted lesson} other {# posted lessons}}

nativeFinance.reviewRequired: This lesson has an exact agreement. Review the completed lesson and its agreement before approving. Nothing was posted.
nativeFinance.groupReviewRequired: Review the applicable group agreement before approving. If multiple group agreements apply, resolve the overlap first. Nothing was posted.
nativeFinance.reviewMismatch: This agreement belongs to a different completed lesson. Nothing was posted.
nativeFinance.title: Native finance ledger
nativeFinance.description: Approve obligations, record received money, allocate and correct with explicit authorization.
nativeFinance.warning: Recording here does not charge a card, send a refund, issue a tax receipt or mark an invoice paid. Verify external money movement separately.
nativeFinance.sessionId: Completed lesson UUID (blank for fixed monthly amount)
nativeFinance.confirm: Confirm immutable financial posting? For refunds, funds must already have been returned outside the app.
nativeFinance.saved: Record saved. Verify the resulting ledger.
nativeFinance.limit: Latest {limit} entries per type; older history is retained.

exactSponsor.willHold: Approving this sponsorship permanently puts automatic invoicing and prepaid credits for this lesson and participant under finance review, even if you archive the sponsorship later.
exactSponsor.replayReceipt: Previous approval receipt confirmed. It describes the original action, not necessarily the current sponsorship.
exactSponsor.refreshFailed: The approval receipt is confirmed, but the current sponsorship could not be loaded. Review this lesson again before taking another action.
exactSponsor.heading: Single-lesson participant sponsorship
exactSponsor.description: Choose one completed lesson and one attendee. This sets terms only. It does not post debt, issue an invoice, grant access, or record payment.
exactSponsor.witness: Automatic invoices and prepaid credit for this participant and lesson require a separate finance review, even after sponsorship is archived.
exactSponsor.saved: Sponsorship terms saved. No charge or payment was posted.
exactSponsor.archived: Sponsorship archived. Automatic billing still requires finance review.
exactSponsor.unavailable: Cannot verify the complete choices. Check the workplace and date.
exactSponsor.changed: The approval could not proceed. Review the exact lesson and finance state again.
exactSponsor.uncertain: The outcome could not be verified. Retry this exact request before starting another approval.
exactSponsor.confirm: Approve {model} terms of {amount} minor units ({currency}) for {student}, paid by {payer}, for {lesson} on {day}? This does not post a charge.
exactSponsor.archiveConfirm: Archive sponsorship for {student} in {lesson} on {day}? Automatic invoices and prepaid credits still require a finance review.

privateSeriesCompensation.overlap: An active agreement already overlaps these dates.
privateSeriesCompensation.overlapChanged: Another approval now overlaps these dates. Review the current series before choosing different dates.
privateSeriesCompensation.payerChanged: The billing account is no longer available. Review the current series and choose an active account.
privateSeriesCompensation.alreadyPosted: An earning is already posted for this lesson. Review the current series; do not approve it again.
privateSeriesCompensation.heading: Private recurring coach rates
privateSeriesCompensation.description: Set prospective terms for one private recurring series. Review verified completed lessons and approve one earning at a time. This does not charge a participant, issue an invoice, or record payment.
privateSeriesCompensation.forecast: Unposted estimate for verified lessons: {amount}. Already posted, exact terms and unverified history are not included.
privateSeriesCompensation.dateEvidence: Actual taught date: {day}. Original recurrence date: {original}.
privateSeriesCompensation.unavailable: Could not verify this complete scope.
privateSeriesCompensation.refreshFailed: Approval receipt confirmed. Reopen the current series review before another action.
privateSeriesCompensation.replay: Previous approval receipt confirmed. The current review may have changed.
privateSeriesCompensation.termsSaved: Prospective terms saved. No earning was posted.
privateSeriesCompensation.posted: Coach earning posted. No payment was recorded.
privateSeriesCompensation.changed: The review changed. Reload this exact scope before approving.
privateSeriesCompensation.uncertain: Outcome not verified. Retry the identical request before starting another approval.
privateSeriesCompensation.confirmTerms: Approve {model} coach terms of {amount} at {venue} for {root}, {from} through {to}? This does not post an earning.
privateSeriesCompensation.confirmArchive: Archive the prospective coach terms for {root}, {from} through {to}?
privateSeriesCompensation.confirmPost: Post {amount} as a coach earning for {lesson} in {root}, taught {day}, counterparty {payer}? No payment is recorded.
privateSeriesCompensation.payer_review: The reviewed billing account is not active.
